skill_name: Identify all the business risks associated with a company.
workflow: The business risks associated with a company may include financial risk, operational risk, market risk, liquidity risk, reputational risk, legal risk, security risk, strategic risk, and regulatory risk. Financial risk involves the possibility of losses due to fluctuations in asset prices or unanticipated liabilities.
